stages.name: Historical change inventory and evidence baseline
stages.goal: Index the entire Build #1 through Build #232 history, including failed/cancelled runs, commits, renames, deletions, original ownership and still-present behavior. This is NOT a last-build-only diff.
focus: Use Actions pagination and bounded compare windows, never a single capped 300-file comparison
Map build run -> SHA -> branch -> result -> affected paths; don't infer failure cause from conclusion alone
Build a deduplicated historical file inventory and current tracked-file inventory, including removed files
Identify historical changes plausibly regressing later builds without presuming causation
stages.stop: All run-number windows accounted for or explicitly marked unavailable; current files enumerated; comparison-truncation gaps named; NO production edits

stages.name: Installation, lifecycle, keyboard activation and MUL
stages.goal: Trace first-install/onboarding and host-extension launch to the actual first visible keyboard; review MUL, OS input mode, empty/incorrect board, fallback and native Globe as distinct gates.
focus: Inspect cold installation versus subsequent activation and app-to-keyboard state transfer
Distinguish primaryLanguage=mul from displayed preferred layout and iOS keyboard selection
Check reentry, duplicate initialization, owner identity, vanished views and inaccessible settings
Trace early historical introduction/removal of alternative boot paths
stages.stop: Every source-owned first-launch transition has owner, stale/cancel/retry path and test oracle; remaining iPhone-only checks marked not_run

stages.name: UIKit, SwiftUI, touch, haptics, sounds, native Emoji and UI
stages.goal: Inspect keyboard rendering, interaction ownership, event duplication, feedback persistence/fallback, system Globe/Emoji and accessibility across historical changes.
focus: Exactly one gesture/one character/one feedback; no duplicate UIKit/SwiftUI touch owners
CoreHaptics prewarm error, UIKit/Sensory fallback; persisted preference versus actual physical feedback
Native Globe tap/hold and actual Emoji History must not be conflated
Keyboard kind, symbol boundaries, dynamic height, first appearance and accessibility labels
stages.stop: Event and rendering owners mapped and line-level defects supported or dismissed; device-dependent findings not marked pass

stages.name: Mic session, audio, ASR/Live Dictation, native workers and memory
stages.goal: Inspect full model/audio lifecycle and every implicit cancellation/ownership gate from historical builds through cold Qwen repair.
focus: Warm/cold retries and host handshake verified by actual engine health, not stale flags
AVAudioSession resource release vs intentional arming; manual Stop, interruption and timeout
Native asynchronous load/unload/decode races, cancellation, memory pressure and safe fallback
Peak RAM, audio buffers, worker accounting, first-attempt Live and history recovery
stages.stop: Each endSession/suspend/unload/rearm caller and dependent state mapped; unmeasured memory issues labelled hypotheses

stages.name: Voice-to-host delivery, document ownership, LLM and output
stages.goal: Audit cross-process request identity, live/final transcription delivery, LLM transforms and exact host insertion safety.
focus: Prove original-document ownership before automatic insert; no unrelated field writes
Exactly-once delivery acknowledgment, stale token, cancellation and no-output retry
Documentless hosts and session/epoch recovery remain fail-closed
Undo/Redo, AI selected text, translation output, history and clipboard permissions
stages.stop: Delivery path has positive, foreign-field and interrupted cases; no invented host-specific runtime evidence

stages.name: App Group, preferences, settings, onboarding, storage and downloads
stages.goal: Audit all persistent settings and model/data lifecycle, including upgrades, resets, migrations, device reinstall and corruption recovery.
focus: Shared-defaults source of truth across app/extension; explicit OFF vs nil and cold cache
Haptic and sound chosen setting persists across keyboard controllers and app relaunch
Model-download cancel/retry, disk reserve, cleanup and mismatched generation
History/export/import/corrections/Emoji History/last-model preservation and reset impact
stages.stop: All discovered stored keys with destructive/reset/migration effect have owner and negative check

stages.name: Multilingual IME, suggestions, Cantonese variants, swipe and Emoji history
stages.goal: Review implementation and historical changes to Cantonese/English/German input, language priority, symbol/shapes, live suggestions and emoji state.
focus: MUL system language metadata vs actual user-visible language layout and preferences
Jyutping/Yale/Sidney Lau, HK colloquial traditional characters, fuzzy maps and exact candidate ownership
English/German suggestions and next-word suggestions after commits
Emoji catalog/history persistence versus native iOS Emoji keyboard picker
Swipe path touch ownership and off-by-one/gesture-trigger duplication
stages.stop: Language route and persistence state have test evidence or explicit device-only gap; earlier code variants considered

stages.name: Everything-else cross-domain audit and historical regressions
stages.goal: Sweep every unreviewed source path and cross-module seam including Meetings, Conversation, translation, ASR/AI models, privacy/diagnostics, performance, release config and unexplained historical regressions.
focus: Use coverage.json to find ALL unreviewed files; account for each as reviewed/excluded/not_reviewed
Check any implicit state gateway absent, not just ones in X1-X6
Speech/model sharing with meeting/conversation, audio capture, playback, LLM, export and failures
GitHub history, package dependencies, privacy, instrumentation, resource leaks and process termination
Reconcile historical source-only artifacts and stale docs with actual HEAD; no speculative false positives
stages.stop: Full current-file accounting, historical-changes ledger accounted; high-risk seams have verified defect/disposition, unresolved gaps recorded

stages.name: Verified root-cause repairs, tests and one unsigned TEST IPA
stages.goal: Prioritize confirmed findings across X0-X7, implement bounded root-cause repairs on fresh main, re-review with both lenses, and obtain a TEST unsigned IPA only when warranted.
focus: Predeclare weighted acceptance cases per real repair; critical/mandatory floors always block
Fix one canonical owner and immediate consumers, not layered workaround/version forks
Check main live HEAD and competing work; main only, no PR or merge, fast-forward only
New diagnostics when behavior changes; no private typing/audio, bounded App Group logging
Run cheapest regression gates first; build exactly one necessary TEST IPA if changes compile
stages.stop: All critical/high findings either fixed with evidence or explicitly blocked; score >=90 per completed repair and mandatory tests pass; iPhone acceptance remains separate

stages.name: Core runtime and shared ownership
stages.goal: Inspect every unreviewed non-UI production Swift/ObjC file; trace owning state, callers, recovery, security and tests
focus: Inspect every unreviewed non-UI production Swift/ObjC file; trace owning state, callers, recovery, security and tests
Use two independent lenses: Untangle canonical state owner; manual OCR-style correctness and failure review
Mark reviewed/reviewed_limited/blocked with pinned SHA, exact code/asset evidence and test oracle; do not equate queued with reviewed
Deduplicate findings before allocating new IDs; never expose user text/audio/credentials
stages.stop: All 65 assigned files have an evidence-based disposition and no P0 risk is silently skipped; unresolved runtime/device checks remain explicitly not_run

stages.name: Independent reconciliation, acceptance and device evidence
stages.goal: Reconcile X0-X13 including live main source drift, all verified findings, CI tests, iPhone evidence and mandatory per-task >=90% acceptance
focus: No hidden unreviewed/excluded sources, no silent high-severity bypass
Independent fresh-context manual review; external Alibaba OCR CLI not run unless expressly approved
Physical iPhone and app/keyboard App Group interaction evidence cannot come from CI
Do not declare Release Candidate without explicit user approval
stages.stop: All X8-X13 review/acceptance gates met, or explicit block with preserved evidence and no promotion

stages.name: Durable archive and explicitly approved cleanup
stages.goal: Preserve a concise technical audit summary in an approved stable GitHub location before considering removal of temporary review evidence
focus: Verify all acceptance and review gates
Preserve user data confidentiality and prior accepted IPA
Obtain explicit user authorization before deleting review files or branch
Remember Git deletion does not erase prior commit blobs
stages.stop: User-approved archival/retention and, only when authorized, verified cleanup. Otherwise remain blocked with evidence retained.

stages.name: Draft intake: iPhone findings and approval decisions
stages.goal: Record reproducible observations against a pinned TEST IPA and decide what to repair during Grill Me; do not implement speculative fixes.
focus: Recheck live main, matching SHA and Actions artifact before treating test results as comparable
Deduplicate new user reports against F-0001–F-0050; log a new draft ID only for a distinct issue
Record expected, observed, environment, reproduction and recovery without raw text, audio or secrets
Grill Me resolves scope, severity and acceptance before a draft is promoted
stages.stop: Every submitted finding is reproduced or clearly marked unverified/deferred; user chooses the approved repair scope. This is NOT a device-pass gate.

stages.name: Host-field, microphone and result recovery safety
stages.goal: Prevent cross-field insertion, double delivery, lost ASR/AI results and unsafe microphone session transitions.
focus: Compare repaired current source with existing X8 matrices before editing; do not add a second recovery owner
Prove original-field ownership and safe fail-closed/manual recovery with synthetic two-field cases
Trace manual Stop/cancel/reentry, one-shot arming, late callbacks and exactly-once/at-most-once insertion
Keep diagnostics bounded, privacy-safe and resilient across App Group restarts
stages.stop: Each approved change passes predeclared critical automated boundaries and >=90% verified per-task case weight; physical original-field/mic approval remains separate and must pass before closure.
stages.code_edits: only after user approves scope; production owner policy must be reconciled with X8

stages.name: History, persistence, deletion and export integrity
stages.goal: Make stored dictation/meeting data recoverable and deletion/export truthful despite interruption and corrupt metadata.
focus: Use synthetic fixtures for corrupt index, partially removed audio and interrupted transfer
Never report deletion or save success before verified durable state; preserve recoverable user audio
Reconcile export/delete category scope, orphan files and persisted settings across host/extension
Test failure, restart, retry and rollback; no destructive real user-data migration
stages.stop: Every approved read/write/delete/export failure case is supported by deterministic evidence, zero unacknowledged data loss, per-task >=90% gates and explicit device testing where needed.
stages.code_edits: only after user approves scope; no migration without rollback

stages.name: Cantonese ASR, models and resource reliability
stages.goal: Verify WSYue SenseVoice and HK Cantonese Qwen3 GGUF installation, integrity, recovery and memory; preserve other models.
focus: Distinguish existing source fixes from unverified legacy F-IDs; do not reset verified models
Reproduce corrupt/truncated file, wrong digest, partial download and version change using fixtures
Verify optional fallback after cancellation and offline failure without unintended downloads
Measure real per-model memory/latency before imposing device thresholds; compare Cantonese, English and German scope
stages.stop: Approved model-integrity cases pass with prior models intact, verified checksums, observable recovery, per-task >=90% acceptance and device performance characterized rather than assumed.
stages.code_edits: only after user approves scope; reuse current model and diagnostic modules

stages.name: Keyboard lifecycle, touch and accessibility
stages.goal: Verify first keyboard appearance, native Globe/Emoji, haptics, gestures, onboarding, VoiceOver and localized tutorials.
focus: Confirm F-0048/F-0050 source patches in #248 before deciding further action
Do not replace native input-mode switching with a custom duplicate owner
Test gesture cancellation, exactly-one key/feedback, keyboard height and reentry state
VoiceOver and Reduce Motion must retain meaningful actions without changing visual controls needlessly
stages.stop: Approved deterministic UI cases pass and iPhone native picker, touch, accessibility and tutorial behaviour have direct human evidence; per-task >=90% gate is not inferred from code.
stages.code_edits: only after user approves scope; no redesign without user choice

stages.name: Multilingual typing, translation and text integrity
stages.goal: Protect output fidelity for Cantonese, English and German, including swipe geometry, next-word context and LLM output.
focus: Treat F-0043 punctuation handling as source-patched in #248, not device-proven
Use synthetic positive and counterexample cases for apostrophes, decimals, wrong-language short outputs and Unicode boundary
Prove German Ü/ß swipe coordinates against actual keyboard shape
Keep Cantonese context tied to confirmed insertion and invalidate on field/cursor changes
stages.stop: All approved text/selection boundaries are deterministic and do not corrupt insertion; per-task >=90% verified, iPhone speech and swipe acceptance separate.
stages.code_edits: only after user approves scope; do not replace original input owners

stages.name: Executable regression gate and development acceptance
stages.goal: Close only evidence-backed repairs, establish native Swift Testing execution, reconcile X8/X14 without rewriting historical evidence and preserve X15 cleanup approval.
focus: Determine cheapest supported native-test destination on available Xcode runner; no second IPA workflow
Demonstrate negative-control failure and positive test execution; build success alone is not native or device acceptance
Recheck all committed patches against live source, findings register and predeclared per-task >=90% mandatory gates
Preserve working IPA and user review branch; no RC or archival cleanup without explicit approval
stages.stop: No critical unverified mandatory case is reported as passed; native tests and a matching exact-SHA TEST IPA have observable results; user separately accepts required device cases. X15 cleanup stays separately approval-gated.
stages.code_edits: only if explicitly authorized, using existing workflow, no duplicate release path

continuation_policy: X9-X13 may progress sequentially as READ-ONLY source reviews while X8 functional/iPhone acceptance remains open. X14 requires all; X15 requires explicit cleanup approval. X16-X22 are proposals only. They may receive user device findings but do not supersede X8 or X14, change main, or authorize X15 cleanup until explicitly promoted after Grill Me.

draft_extension.notes: Future repair programme, NOT a claim that X8/X14/X15 are complete; no X17+ production write until X8 owner policy is explicitly reconciled.
